ViGALT_ablation.alt_text: A sweater has a light-gray body with repeating vertical zigzag bands filled with small diamond texture. Brown contrast panels run along the outer lower sleeves, with ribbed knit cuffs at the sleeve ends. The raised collar opens into a short front placket with a dark button near the upper chest, and a ribbed knit hem runs along the bottom edge.
